description_en: Queries the status of a device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备的状态
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual get-device-status --product-key a1Bw000000 --device-name Device01 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2023-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeviceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the video device.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video device.
<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。
<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call was successful

Status.description_en:
The current status of the device. Valid values:

ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备当前状态。

ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
